about: The mini-map on whatever floor the server opens; sends nothing. Run with ?minimap=inline (the same canvas the floating window holds, drawn into the page at the bottom right, so a headless test can see and click it). The map icon stands in the top-right row between the usage gauge and the rail's icon (usage gauge, map, rail icon, plug, folder: one top, one size, even gaps, none touching); while the mini-map is closed nothing of it runs. A click on the icon opens it: it draws the floor's real agents, a name in the list for every running or waiting one, each joined to its bar by a line, no two texts overlapping, no line through another agent's name; the finished agents of the last hour are listed below the divider (those with something for you first, then latest first, at most five, '+N more' for the rest) and none of them has a number on the floor. Attention, as on the main floor (one list for every surface, the engine's): an agent on the list shows the icon in its logo's place above its number and before its name in the list (a finished one: on top of its bar where there is room); the header says no count in the page (the agent tree's head says it), 'N need you' in the floating window; hovering an icon says what it is, clicking it does what the main floor's icon does, and 'N need you' steps to the next agent that needs you. Plan use: one tiny bar per harness with a plan reading at the header's right end, the same harnesses as the usage gauge; hovering one lists its windows with their reset times. Closing an open folder on the main floor turns it into a closed tile on the mini floor, and opening it again turns it back. A click on a running or waiting agent in the mini-map focuses that column on the main floor and flies the camera to it. Pointing at a finished name lights its bar (skipped when none finished in the last hour). The icon again closes it and its timer stops.

actions.note: the time rail is hidden by default on a live floor (2026-11-13): its icon shows it, for the steps that use it
